```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity Value'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent" NDATA bin>
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "urn:notation">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- This is a top-level comment describing the root element -->
  <sub:child>
    <?sub-pi target="data" processing="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing complex markup characters: <tag> & "quotes"
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA | section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
]>
<doc xmlns="http://w3.org/xml/default" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/custom">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
  <!-- Author: Test Suite -->
  <custom:section>
    <![CDATA[ Unparsed CDATA with <tag> and &entity; reference inside. ]]>
    &ent2;
  </custom:section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % remote SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd-fragment.dtd">
  %remote;
  <!ENTITY local "Local Entity">
  <?target-pi data="processingInstructionValue"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:auth.008" xmlns:ns1="urn:schema:one">
  <!-- Root level comment -->
  <ns1:item>
    <![CDATA[
      Some nested CDATA block with arbitrary text & symbols.
    ]]>
    &local;
  </ns1:item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY reference "Entity expansion string">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY externalDoc SYSTEM "file:///etc/hosts" NDATA pdf>
]>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
  <!-- A comment before the main node structure -->
  <node xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      <!DOCTYPE nested-cdata-simulation>
      <tag>content inside cdata</tag>
    ]]>
    &reference;
  </node>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY bio "&author; is a writer.">
  <!NOTATION gif SYSTEM "image/gif">
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://books.example.com/ns" xmlns:bib="http://books.example.com/bib">
  <?book-manager action="initialize" version="1.0"?>
  <!-- Comprehensive inventory list containing rare constructs -->
  <bib:book>
    <![CDATA[
      Special CDATA block: &author; will not be expanded here.
    ]]>
    &bio;
  </bib:book>
</inventory>
```
